title: OpenAI's o1 is built to think before it answers
summary: OpenAI released o1-preview, the first of a new series of reasoning models that spend extra time working through a problem before they reply. OpenAI says it handles hard science, math, and coding problems much better than its earlier models. It launched in ChatGPT and for developers through OpenAI's API, with usage limits, and couldn't yet browse the web or read uploaded files.
why_it_matters: OpenAI said its older GPT-4o model was still the better choice for most everyday questions. o1 is aimed at problems that need careful, step-by-step work.
